concerns.text: Task T300 specifies creating `results/false_positive_burden_<species>.tsv` but does not define any verification (e.g., unit test or CI step) to confirm the file’s existence, schema compliance, or correctness of the Poisson calculation.

Task T301 extends per‑species summary generation to include false‑positive burden metrics but lacks a concrete verification artifact (unit test, integration test, or CI check) to ensure the summary actually incorporates the new metrics.

Task T303 updates `docs/README.md` with a “False‑Positive Burden” section but provides no test or documentation‑build verification to guarantee the changes are rendered correctly and remain in sync with the code.
Task T304 updates `docs/quickstart.md` to mention the false‑positive analysis step, yet no test or CI validation is specified to ensure the quickstart instructions remain accurate.

Task T305 implements a calibration assessment script `src/pipeline/calibration.py` but does not include any verification (unit test, integration test, or CI step) to confirm the script runs, produces the expected `results/calibration_<species>.tsv`, and adheres to its contract.

The new Phase 9 tasks introduce several artifacts (e.g., `master_results.json` mentioned in the plan) without any corresponding creation or validation tasks, leaving the Single Source of Truth principle unverified.
